finding.scenario: A credential string straddling the 10KiB logging boundary loses its closing quote, bypassing both complete JSON redaction and fallback regex. The actual Logger writes the partial credential to request_body/response_body; storage backend configuration is one real credential-bearing route not excluded from body logging.
finding.before: 2 actual Gin Logger cases fail; valid JSON with a normal-length fixture credential at the logging cutoff; .git/module-audit-20261113/logger-truncation-before.log
finding.fix: Omit the captured body when truncated; keep access metadata and short-body redaction, and replay request bytes unchanged to handlers.

limitations: Response capture conservatively omits bodies exactly at its 10KiB cap as well; no response or request delivery changes.
Generated credentials only, no real credentials or user log files read. Tests assert log JSON and original request/response bytes.
This does not claim all malformed textual body formats are completely redacted.
